Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesized that Norris Bradbury was the director of the project at Los Alamos. In the second turn, the Planner states, "Likely answer: Norris Bradbury, who directed Los Alamos (Project Y) and oversaw the assembly of the first atomic device." This is a factual error; while Bradbury was the Laboratory Director from 1946 to 1953, J. Robert Oppenheimer was the scientific director during the Manhattan Project (1943–1945) when the first atomic bomb was developed. The Planner later corrected this in Turn 3, but the initial error in Turn 2 led to a period of confusion and redundant search efforts focusing on Bradbury before settling on the correct answer.
